args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Combined Summary (Brightline)
args.body:
Combined summary of the Brightline cold-chain article and its companion piece:

- Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilots cut claims by a quarter.

Sources: https://blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain and https://insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion (accessed via free registration with lucas.castillo@northwind.example).
